name: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Trophy Scheme
benefit:
Top 3 (three) recognized Universities on the basis of overall marks secured will be awarded. The amount of cash prizes is mentioned below respectively: 1st position: ₹ 15,00,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Lakh Only)2nd position: ₹ 7,50,000/- (Rupees Seven Lakh Fifty Thousand Only) 3rd position:
₹ 4,50,000/- (Rupees Four Lakh Fifty Thousand Only) The cash award money received by the winning Universities under the Scheme should be spent for promotion of sports including opening of Centre of Excellence, creation/upgradation of infrastructure, training of athletes, cash award to sportspersons, etc.
eligibility_rules: FOR UNIVERSITIESUniversities recognized by Government/UGC are only eligible for nomination under this scheme. ELIGIBLE SPORTS DISCIPLINESSports disciplines to be considered for the MAKA Trophy Award will be based on the following conditions: 1) The sports disciplines should be recognized by the MYAS; and
The sports disciplines should also be part of Olympics/Asian Games/Commonwealth Games.
Apart from the above, the following three sports disciplines are included based on popularity / indignity: (i) Chess, (ii) Kho-kho, (iii) Cricket
documents_required: Signed Undertaking to be given by the Vice
Chancellor of the contesting University (As per given format)
Complete self computed proposal with all relevant documents in a single
PDF, duly indexed & page numbered (max upto 50MB)
how_to_apply: Mode: OnlineStep 1: The applicant will open the website https://dbtyas-sports.gov.in/ to registerand apply for Online Schemes of the Department of Sports.Step 2: The applicant will click on the 'Registration' tab to start the one-time registration process. Here the applicant will fill in the required personal details including verification of their mobile number through OTP.(Registration Type, Organization Name, Individual Name, Address, State, City, District, Block, Village, Pin Code, Email, Mobile Number)Step 3: After successful registration, the applicant will get the message that the login credentials have been sent to the registered email ID.Step 4: The applicant will use the login credentials received on the registered emailID to login into the online portal. Please remember to refresh the captcha before clicking on the login button.Step 5: After first-time login, the applicant will be required to update their other basic details. After filling in the details click on the 'Update' button and the profile will be successfully updated.Step 6: The applicant will click on the 'Schemes' tab and apply for the desired scheme.
